item.title: Missouri linebacker Damon Wilson II accuses Georgia of illegal punishment in transfer portal lawsuit
item.description: Missouri pass rusher Damon Wilson II claims that the athletic department at Georgia is trying to illegally punish him for entering the transfer portal in a lawsuit filed by the linebacker in state court Tuesday in Boone County, Missouri. item.title: College Football Playoff ratings drop 7% as NFL competition impacts viewership
item.description: Last weekend's first round of the College Football Playoff averaged 9.9 million viewers on ABC, ESPN, TNT, TBS and truTV, according to ESPN and Nielson. That is a 7% drop from last year. The post College Football Playoff ratings drop 7% as NFL competition impacts viewership appeared first on The Augusta Press.
